scripts.title: Anti Boombox Fling
scripts.features: Disables collision for any boombox detected so no one can fling or push you anymore.
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function disableRadioMeshCollision(part)
    -- Disable initially
    part.CanCollide = false
    -- Redisable if CanCollide changes back to true
    part.Changed:Connect(function(property)
        if property == "CanCollide" and part.CanCollide == true then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end)
end

local function scanAndDisable(parent)
    for _, obj in pairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "RadioMesh" and obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            disableRadioMeshCollision(obj)
        end
    end
end

-- Initial scan on workspace
scanAndDisable(workspace)

-- Listen for new additions to workspace
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    if obj.Name == "RadioMesh" and obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        disableRadioMeshCollision(obj)
    end
end)

scripts.title: J scripts KEYLESS Ink game
scripts.features: Auto win
scripts.script:
-- GUI Fofa para Ink Game (Delta Executor - Celular) sem chave

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Criar GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
gui.Name = "FofinhaGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Frame principal
local main = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 600)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -300)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 240)
main.Active = true
Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)

-- Sistema de arrastar para celular
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

-- Layout
local uilist = Instance.new("UIListLayout", main)
uilist.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
uilist.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
uilist.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
uilist.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local ordem = 0

-- Função de criar botões
local function criarBotao(texto, cor, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = cor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 150)
	btn.Text = texto
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	ordem += 1
	btn.LayoutOrder = ordem
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- Botões com funções do jogo
criarBotao("🛏 Teleportar Dormitório", nil, function()
	local char = player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-310, 20, -41)
	end
end)

criarBotao("🚦 Final Red Light", nil, function()
	local char = player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-367, 3, -245)
	end
end)

criarBotao("🍪 Final Dalgona", nil, function()
	for _, v in pairs(getgc(true)) do
		if typeof(v) == "function" and debug.getinfo(v).name == "FinishMiniGame" then
			pcall(function() v() end)
		end
	end
end)

criarBotao("🪢 Final Pula Corda", nil, function()
	local char = player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-138, 40, -240)
	end
end)

criarBotao("🪟 Final Ponte de Vidro", nil, function()
	local char = player.Character
	if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(-431, 3, -246)

end
